description: This file appears to be a PHP script involved in creating QuickCreate views or subpanel views dynamically for modules within SuiteCRM/SugarCRM. It handles module validation, includes appropriate view classes, and instantiates and displays views based on request parameters.

classes.name: EditViewQuickCreate
classes.description: Class responsible for managing the QuickCreate view in the EditView module, instantiated when a QuickCreate is requested via module override.

classes.name: SubpanelQuickCreate
classes.description: Default class for handling subpanel quick create views, instantiated when no module-specific override exists.

classes.name: CustomSubpanelQuickCreate
classes.description: Potential override class for subpanel quick create views in custom modules, if it exists.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Method called on the view object to process the request and prepare the view for display.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Method called to render and output the view content.
